description: Capabilities granted to voice typing's paste window: never seen, it is shown for the moment a dictation is typed on Wayland, where only a window that has the keyboard may set the clipboard (src/voicetyping/paste.rs). Its page (ui/src/voicetyping/VoiceTypingPill.svelte) draws nothing and calls nothing; what voice typing shows is a card in the panel. No dialogs, no opener, no notifications.
